Complaint.submitDescription: Send your complaint or feedback to the faculty. You will receive a ticket number and a tracking code to follow it up.
Complaint.ppksNotice: This form is for general complaints. Reports of sexual violence or harassment are handled by the PPKS task force through a separate confidential channel and must not be sent here.
Complaint.trackDescription: Enter the ticket number and tracking code you received when you submitted the complaint.
Complaint.hintDescription: Describe what happened, when, and where, as clearly as you can.
Complaint.hintToken: The long code shown once after you submitted.
Complaint.hintReply: Add new information or answer the officer questions.
Complaint.successBody: An officer will follow it up. Use the ticket number and code below to check its progress.
Complaint.tokenWarning: Save this now. The code is shown once and cannot be reissued. Without it your complaint cannot be opened again.
Complaint.errorRequestInvalid: Check your entries. The subject needs at least 2 characters and the details at least 10.
Complaint.errorRateLimited: Too many complaints from this network within an hour. Try again later.
Complaint.errorNotFound: The ticket number and tracking code do not match. Check both.
Complaint.errorValidationFailed: This complaint is closed and no longer accepts replies.
Complaint.errorUnavailable: The service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
Complaint.confidentialBody: For confidentiality the content is not shown on a public page. Only the PPKS task force can open it. What you can follow here is how it is progressing.

Booking.listDescription: Faculty rooms available for academic and student activities.
Booking.requestDescription: Fill in your schedule and purpose. An officer reviews every request before approval.

Booking.noRooms: No rooms are available for booking yet.
Booking.hintRoom: Check that the room is large enough for your group.
Booking.hintTime: Use Jakarta time (WIB). One request may not exceed 24 hours.
Booking.hintPurpose: Name the activity and who is running it.
Booking.hintApplicationLetter: Upload an official PDF letter, max 10MB. Requests without a letter cannot be processed.

Ppks.title: Report sexual violence or harassment
Ppks.description: This channel is handled by the PPKS task force. You do not have to give your name to report.
Ppks.immediateDangerNotice: If you are in immediate danger, contact the authorities or someone you trust right away.
Ppks.contactSapa: SAPA, Ministry of Women Empowerment and Child Protection
Ppks.institutionalContactPending: The faculty PPKS task force contact will appear here once verified. For now, use the channels above.
Ppks.confidentialityTitle: What to know before you report
Ppks.confidentialityRead: Only the PPKS task force can read this report. Faculty leadership and other officers cannot open it.
Ppks.confidentialityAnonymous: You may report without a name. No identity field is required.
Ppks.confidentialityCompanion: You have the right to be accompanied by someone you trust throughout the process.
Ppks.confidentialityWithdraw: You have the right to withdraw the report at any time.
Ppks.hintReporterRole: You may leave this blank if you prefer not to say.
Ppks.hintSubject: Optional. One sentence is enough if you want one.
Ppks.hintDescription: Tell us as much as you are comfortable with. There is no format to follow, and you do not have to explain everything now.
Ppks.hintIdentity: Optional. Leave it empty to report entirely anonymously. If filled, only the PPKS task force can read it.
Ppks.hintAttachments: Optional. Up to 3 files, PDF or image, 5 MB each. Original filenames are not stored.
Ppks.fieldDanger: There is an ongoing threat to safety.
Ppks.hintDanger: If ticked, your report is marked urgent and handled first.
Ppks.successBody: The PPKS task force will follow it up. Only they can read what you wrote.
Ppks.tokenWarning: Save this now. Because a report may be anonymous, this code is your only way to check its status. It cannot be reissued.
Ppks.closingNote: This system is a channel for receiving reports. It does not replace the task force official handling process.
Ppks.errorRequestInvalid: The account of what happened needs a few sentences.
Ppks.errorRateLimited: Too many submissions from this network within an hour. If this is urgent, use the contacts above.
Ppks.errorUnavailable: The reporting channel cannot accept reports right now. If this is urgent, use the contacts above.

AdminPpks.title: PPKS reports
AdminPpks.description: Only the PPKS task force can open a report. Every opening is recorded.
AdminPpks.notConfigured: The PPKS encryption key is not configured, so reports can be neither opened nor received. Contact the system administrator.
AdminPpks.noAccess: You do not have access to this channel.
AdminPpks.listNotice: This list deliberately carries no summary or account of the report. Open a report to read it, and that opening will be recorded.
AdminPpks.accessLogged: Opening this report is written to an access log that cannot be deleted.
AdminPpks.reporterAnonymous: Anonymous. The reporter chose not to give an identity.
AdminPpks.attachmentsNotice: Attachments are stored encrypted outside the public directory.
AdminPpks.aggregateOnly: Only the PPKS task force can open a report. You can see the counts above.
AdminPpks.composerTitle: Write a reply or a note
AdminPpks.replyPublicHint: The reporter will see this message on the tracking page.
AdminPpks.replyInternalHint: This note is for the task force only. The reporter will never see it.
AdminPpks.priorityReasonHint: Required. A change of priority on a PPKS report has to be accountable.
AdminPpks.assignEmpty: No active PPKS task force member yet.
AdminPpks.closeHint: The resolution is stored encrypted and readable only by the task force.
AdminPpks.errorSession: Your session ended, or you are not a PPKS task force member.
AdminPpks.errorUnavailable: The change could not be saved. Try again shortly.
